data.desc: BTCS Inc. ('BTCS' or the 'Company'), short for Blockchain Technology Consensus Solutions, is a Nasdaq-listed operating company that offers public-market access to the blockchain economy. Imperium, the Company's decentralized finance ('DeFi') business, deploys capital into on-chain liquidity markets, including automated market maker pools on Ethereum and Layer-2 networks, to generate recurring, high-margin revenue. Imperium draws on the protocol-level expertise of BTCS's Ethereum infrastructure operations, Builder+ (block building) and NodeOps (staking). BTCS funds its growth through the DeFi/TradFi Accretion Flywheel, an integrated approach to raising capital, accumulating digital assets and deploying them on chain.
